_note: TikTok uses the same schedule as Instagram (social/instagram/config.json schedule_slots: 06:00 and 16:00 America/New_York) and the same queue folders.
_mode_note: photo = PHOTO post (PULL_FROM_URL) of post_9x16.jpg; video = a short Ken Burns MP4 built with ffmpeg from post_9x16.jpg, posted with PULL_FROM_URL.
_privacy_note: Unaudited TikTok apps can only post SELF_ONLY (private). After TikTok approves the app audit, set PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE (must be one of the creator's privacy_level_options from creator_info).
_image_note: Public base URL on a domain/URL prefix verified in the TikTok developer app (e.g. https://urbanstone.co/social). Queue files are appended as <base>/<queue_id>/<file>.
